name: agentpay-extract-mcp-server
title: AgentPay Web Extract
summary: Turns any web page URL into clean markdown plus title, metadata, Open Graph, canonical URL and outbound links. Listing tools is free; tool calls are paid per call.
description: AgentPay Web Extract is a remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP, stateless) with one tool, extract_page, which fetches a URL at request time and returns clean, LLM-ready markdown together with the page title, metadata, Open Graph tags, canonical URL and outbound links. Connecting, initialize and tools/list are free and need no account or API key. Each tool call costs $0.005 USDC and is paid either per call with x402 (USDC on Base, eip155:8453, or on Algorand) passed in the tool call's _meta field, or by sending an optional Authorization: Bearer header with a prepaid credits key bought at https://agentpay.agentpay-apis.workers.dev/credits/buy. Tool calls send the requested URL and any supplied options to AgentPay.

useCases.name: Web page to markdown
useCases.description: Convert an article, documentation page or other public URL into clean markdown for summarization, retrieval-augmented generation or citation.

useCases.name: Page metadata and links
useCases.description: Read a page's title, description, Open Graph tags, canonical URL and outbound links for link previews, SEO checks or crawl planning.
